summary: Per second on the size you asked for, out of a monthly plan that is also a credit; storage bills in every state.

egress.note: Sending is capped at about 50 Mbit/s per machine.
egress.included: 100 GiB on Free, 1 TiB on Pro, 5 TiB on Builder, 50 TiB on Team

notes: The free plan is one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine that pauses after 30 idle minutes; it is not priced here.
Egress is $0.02 per GiB beyond each plan's included allowance.
The first 20 GiB of each paid machine's /data disk is free in every state; only disk beyond it bills.
Sizes are 2 GiB of memory per vCPU: Pro allows 2/4, 4/8 and 8/16, Builder up to 16/32 and Team up to 32/64, with disk up to 200, 500 and 1,024 GiB.
sleeps: An idle machine pauses itself and wakes when its preview link is used; paused time bills storage only. A manual pause does not wake on use.

upkeep.label: Updates not published
upkeep.detail: Machines are kept between runs and you install software with apt. InstaBox does not say who patches a machine you keep.

source.quote: apt manages the machine's own system
